description: Search public SpareRoom.co.uk room listings by location, rent, radius and filters, or fetch full details for specific listing URLs.

billsIncluded.description: Only include adverts that state bills are included in the rent.
billsIncluded.title: Bills included only

city.description: UK city, town, neighbourhood or postcode (for example London, Manchester, Camden, SW2). A SpareRoom /flatshare/... URL is also accepted. Used in search mode.
city.title: City or area

disabledAccess.description: Only include properties with disabled access.
disabledAccess.title: Disabled access only

freeToContact.description: Only include adverts that are free to contact.
freeToContact.title: Free to contact only

furnished.description: Filter by furnished or unfurnished adverts.
furnished.title: Furnishing

keyword.description: Only include adverts whose text matches this keyword, for example tube, ensuite, garden.
keyword.title: Keyword

maxBeds.description: Only include properties with at most this many bedrooms (6 means 6+ on SpareRoom).
maxBeds.title: Maximum bedrooms in property

maxBudget.description: Only include rooms advertised at or below this monthly rent. Weekly adverts are matched by SpareRoom's own monthly conversion.
maxBudget.title: Maximum rent (GBP per month)

maxItems.description: Stop after this many listings. SpareRoom itself exposes at most 1,000 results per search.
maxItems.title: Maximum listings

milesFromCenter.description: Search radius around the chosen location. SpareRoom's own selector uses 0-5, 10, 15, 20, 30 and 40 miles.
milesFromCenter.title: Search radius (miles)

minBeds.description: Only include properties with at least this many bedrooms.
minBeds.title: Minimum bedrooms in property

minBudget.description: Only include rooms advertised at or above this monthly rent.
minBudget.title: Minimum rent (GBP per month)

mode.description: Search current room listings, or fetch full details for a list of SpareRoom listing URLs.
enumTitles: Search rooms by location and filters
Fetch details for specific listing URLs
Legacy alias: room details by URL
mode.title: Mode

moveInDate.description: Ask SpareRoom for rooms available on or before this date. Leave blank for any date.
moveInDate.title: Move-in date (YYYY-MM-DD)

noDeposit.description: Only include adverts marked as no or low deposit.
noDeposit.title: No / low deposit only

parking.description: Only include properties with parking available.
parking.title: Parking only

petsAllowed.description: Only include adverts where pets are considered.
petsAllowed.title: Pets considered only

photosOnly.description: Only include adverts with at least one photo.
photosOnly.title: Photo adverts only

postedBy.description: Filter by who placed the advert.
postedBy.title: Posted by

propertyType.description: Choose rooms in existing shared houses, studio/1-bed flats, or whole properties suitable for sharing.
propertyType.title: Property type

roomType.description: Narrow results to double rooms, single rooms, en-suite rooms or studio/1-bed properties.
roomType.title: Room type

roomUrls.description: One or more public SpareRoom listing URLs for details mode. Both /flatshare/<area>/<id> and flatshare_detail.pl?flatshare_id=<id> links are accepted.
roomUrls.title: SpareRoom listing URLs

sharedLivingRoom.description: Only include properties with a shared living room.
sharedLivingRoom.title: Shared living room only

shortLet.description: Only include adverts that consider short-term lets.
shortLet.title: Short lets only

sortBy.description: How SpareRoom should order results before collection.
sortBy.title: Sort order
